title: Injection of Space Radiation Errors on Low-power NVM using Generative Deep Learning
authors: Eleonora Giudici, Antonio Miele, Luca Mottola
abstract: We develop an error model for a Non-Volatile Memory (NVM) device that represents the effects of physical faults experienced in a CubeSat mission in Low Earth Orbit (LEO). The CubeSat carries an off-the-shelf low-power Ferroelectric RAM (FRAM) chip and runs repeated read/write tests according to a predefined pattern. We compare every memory snapshot received from the satellite with a reference bitmap to identify bit errors. We visually analyze erroneous values distributions in the memory snapshots and we understand that they are frequently distributed according to regular spatial patterns. We define a generative deep learning technique to automatically learn these spatial patterns and to synthetically generate additional error patterns mimicking the observed ones. The model is capable at producing memory errors for general application-level experimentation. Our preliminary validation indicates that when comparing the model output with the data we collect, 0.92 of the generated bit flips correspond to bit flips in the memory snapshots and the model captures 0.91 of the observed bit flips. A comparison of the spatial distribution of bit flips in 10,000 generated error patterns also provides a Wasserstein distance of 0.073, indicating that the two distributions differ by roughly 7% of the maximum possible displacement of their probability masses.
title_zh: 基于生成式深度学习的低功耗非易失性存储器空间辐射错误注入
abstract_zh: 我们为非易失性存储器(NVM)设备开发了一个错误模型，该模型代表了在低地球轨道(LEO)立方卫星任务中经历的物理故障效应。该立方卫星搭载了一款现成的低功耗铁电随机存取存储器(FRAM)芯片，并根据预定义模式运行重复的读写测试。我们将从卫星接收到的每个内存快照与参考位图进行比较，以识别位错误。我们直观地分析了内存快照中错误值的分布，并了解到它们经常按照规则的空间模式分布。我们定义了一种生成式深度学习技术，用于自动学习这些空间模式，并合成生成模仿观察到的错误模式的附加错误模式。该模型能够为通用应用程序级别的实验生成内存错误。我们的初步验证表明，当将模型输出与收集的数据进行比较时，生成的位翻转中有0.92对应于内存快照中的位翻转，并且模型捕获了0.91的观察到的位翻转。对10,000个生成错误模式中位翻转空间分布的比较也提供了0.073的Wasserstein距离，表明这两个分布的差异约为其概率质量最大可能位移的7%。

title: Function Contracts for Bounded Model Checking of C Programs
authors: Weiqi Wang, Marie Farrell, Liping Zhao, Lucas C. Cordeiro
abstract: Bounded model checking unrolls a program into a single formula, so a function holding a loop costs the solver a fresh copy of that loop at every call site. Function contracts break that coupling. Verify the body once against its contract, then replace each call by a stub derived from it. CBMC supports this through dynamic frame condition checking, applied at industrial scale, but with no formal account of why the replacement is sound and no characterisation of what the frame check costs. We present the function-contract framework for ESBMC. The clause syntax, both phases, and the first assigns enforcement the tool has had are all introduced here. Its technical core is an observational frame rule: snapshot the locations the contract does not permit the function to write, then compare them at exit. The encoding emits a number of verification conditions set by how many globals the program has, not by how many writes the body performs, while dynamic frame condition checking grows with the write count. That is a property of the encoding rather than a timing, so it moves with neither the machine nor the solver. The rule itself is the classical one; what we add is its bounded form inside a BMC encoding, with the pipeline's algebraic skeleton machine-checked in Lean 4 and the limits of that model stated. We evaluate on synthetic sweeps, SV-COMP tasks, an ANSSI X.509 parser, the FreeRTOS heap_1 allocator, and the ML-KEM reference implementation whose CBMC contracts we reuse unchanged. At the coefficient count FIPS-203 mandates, neither tool finishes on the monolithic route inside ten minutes, and both finish on the modular one. The framework is merged into ESBMC master. Contracts are what is left when unrolling runs out of room.
title_zh: C程序有界模型检查的函数合约
abstract_zh: 有界模型检查将程序展开为单个公式，因此包含循环的函数会在每个调用点使求解器产生该循环的一个新副本。函数契约打破了这种耦合。只需根据契约验证函数体一次，然后将每个调用替换为从契约派生的存根。CBMC通过动态帧条件检查支持这一点，该方法已应用于工业规模，但没有对替换为何合理的正式解释，也没有对帧检查成本的描述。我们为ESBMC提出了函数契约框架。本文介绍了子句语法、两个阶段以及工具首次实施的强制执行机制。其核心技术核心是一个观测帧规则：拍摄契约不允许函数写入的位置快照，然后在退出时进行比较。编码产生的验证条件数量由程序中的全局变量数量决定，而非由函数体执行的写入次数决定，而动态帧条件检查的规模则随写入次数增长。这是编码本身的特性，而非时间问题，因此它既不随机器变化，也不随求解器变化。该规则本身是经典的；我们添加的是其在BMC编码内的有界形式，并通过Lean 4对流水线的代数骨架进行了机器检查，并阐明了该模型的局限性。我们在合成测试、SV-COMP任务、ANSSI X.509解析器、FreeRTOS heap_1分配器以及我们重用其CBMC契约不变的ML-KEM参考实现上进行了评估。在FIPS-203规定的系数数量下，两种工具在十分钟内都无法通过单体路线完成，但都能通过模块化路线完成。该框架已合并到ESBMC主分支中。当展开空间耗尽时，契约便成为剩余的部分。

title: Learn the Interface, Not the Implementation: Output Representation Dominates Training Regime in LLM-Based RTL Generation
authors: Siddharth Patel, Vikram Singh, Siddharth Savyasachi Malu, Rohit Singh
abstract: Large-language-model register-transfer-level (RTL) generation has concentrated on how to train the model: fine-tuning, continued pre-training, and reinforcement learning from a verifier. We argue this is the second-order question. On a bounded, formally specifiable task of generating single-error-correcting, double-error-detecting (SECDED) ECC memory wrappers, we hold the task, data, and correctness oracle fixed and vary two axes independently: the training regime (seven settings) and the output representation (four levels, from fully expanded flat Verilog to an eight-field configuration expanded by a deterministic generator). Because a reference generator exists, correctness is decided by formal equivalence over a design space of approximately ten million points, rather than sampled from a hand-written testbench. Two results follow. First, representation dominates: every representation close to raw RTL reaches a pass rate of at most 0.17, while the configuration reaches 0.83 with no training at all. Once the model emits the configuration, every training regime achieves a pass rate between 0.89 and 1.00. Second, raw RTL hits a hard output-length limit: a 512-bit design requires 44,237 tokens of flat Verilog compared with just 69 tokens for the configuration. Consequently, raw generation becomes infeasible above 32-bit data words rather than merely inaccurate. A model trained from scratch with fewer than 50 million parameters, combined with the verified generator, achieves 0.89 formal equivalence, compared with 1.00 for a 32-billion-parameter fine-tuned model, while using approximately 1600 times less inference energy per correct design. Inference energy also dominates amortized training energy. The lesson is to learn the interface, not the implementation.
title_zh: 学习接口而非实现：基于大语言模型的RTL生成中，输出表示主导训练策略
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型寄存器传输级(RTL)生成一直集中在如何训练模型上：微调、持续预训练以及基于验证器的强化学习。我们认为这是二阶问题。在生成单错误纠正、双错误检测(SECDED) ECC内存包装器的有界、可形式化规范的任务中，我们固定任务、数据和正确性验证器，并独立改变两个维度：训练方案（七种设置）和输出表示（四个级别，从完全展开的平面Verilog到由确定性生成器展开的八字段配置）。由于存在参考生成器，正确性是通过约一千万个设计点上的形式等价性来决定的，而不是从手工编写的测试台中采样。由此得出两个结论。首先，表示形式占主导地位：每种接近原始RTL的表示形式的通过率最高仅为0.17，而配置表示形式无需任何训练即可达到0.83的通过率。一旦模型发出配置，每种训练方案都能达到0.89到1.00之间的通过率。其次，原始RTL遇到了硬性的输出长度限制：一个512位的设计需要44,237个平面Verilog标记，而配置表示仅需69个标记。因此，原始生成在32位以上数据字长时变得不可行，而不仅仅是准确性下降。一个从头训练、参数少于5000万的模型，结合经过验证的生成器，能够达到0.89的形式等价性，而一个拥有320亿参数的微调模型则达到1.00，同时每个正确设计使用的推理能量大约减少了1600倍。推理能量也分摊了训练能量。教训是学习接口，而不是实现。

title: A Type System for Communication-Safe Hardware Design
authors: Aditya Ranjan Jha, Jason Zhijingcheng Yu, Umang Mathur, Prateek Saxena
abstract: Hardware components communicate through clock-cycle-sensitive protocols. Hardware Description Languages (HDLs), however, provide limited support for expressing these protocols or for checking that independently developed components agree on them. When components disagree, the composed design can perform unsynchronized exchanges or stop making progress. We call these failures communication-safety violations. Communication safety is therefore a global property, determined by interactions between multiple components. This makes it difficult to check modularly. This paper presents Pact, a typed extension of Anvil for modular verification of communication safety in synchronous hardware. Pact types describe message-passing, control-flow, and clock-cycle behaviour. Each component is checked against its type. Compatible types then guarantee that the components compose into a communication-safe system. Pact also supports incremental design. It can check a subsystem before the full system context is available. The check produces a summary type that captures the communication behaviour left for future compositions. To reduce annotation burden, Pact infers types by abstracting payload values while preserving communication, timing, control, and fairness. These inferred types are optimal for the checker: whenever some checker-accepted types can prove compatibility, the inferred types can prove it as well. Type inference and type checking are decidable, and compatibility is decided by a sound and complete algorithm. We implement Pact by extending the Anvil compiler and evaluate it along four dimensions: detecting communication errors during incremental design, expressiveness on ten clock-cycle-accurate translations of open-source hardware IPs, compatibility-checking time, and generated hardware overhead. Pact expresses realistic protocols and verifies all ten benchmarks in reasonable time.
title_zh: 一种用于通信安全硬件设计的类型系统
abstract_zh: 硬件组件通过时钟周期敏感的协议进行通信。然而，硬件描述语言（HDL）在表达这些协议或检查独立开发的组件是否达成一致方面提供的支持有限。当组件不一致时，组合设计可能会执行不同步的数据交换或停止进展。我们将这些故障称为通信安全违规。因此，通信安全是一个全局属性，由多个组件之间的交互决定。这使得模块化检查变得困难。本文介绍了Pact，它是Anvil的一个类型扩展，用于同步硬件中通信安全的模块化验证。Pact类型描述了消息传递、控制流和时钟周期行为。每个组件都根据其类型进行检查。兼容的类型随后保证组件组合成一个通信安全的系统。Pact还支持增量设计。它可以在完整系统上下文可用之前检查子系统。检查会产生一个摘要类型，捕获留给未来组合的通信行为。为了减少注释负担，Pact通过抽象有效载荷值同时保留通信、时序、控制和公平性来推断类型。这些推断的类型对于检查器是最优的：每当某些检查器接受的类型可以证明兼容性时，推断的类型也可以证明这一点。类型推断和类型检查是可判定的，兼容性由一个健全且完整的算法决定。我们通过扩展Anvil编译器来实现Pact，并从四个维度对其进行评估：在增量设计期间检测通信错误、对十个开源硬件IP的时钟周期精确翻译的表达能力、兼容性检查时间以及生成的硬件开销。Pact表达了现实协议，并在合理时间内验证了所有十个基准测试。

title: SIMD-Accelerated Parity Game Solving for Formal Verification via Strahler Progress Measures
authors: Vanessa Flügel, Marcin Jurdziński, Guillermo A. Pérez
